summary: Frontend-only responsive regression at 390px and 820px (plus 1920 sanity) across admin-E (6 refactored pages), public pages, vendor portal, staff portal, escrow portal and /m/e/supplier. Admin-E shell is clean: exactly 1 visible admin-nav-toggle, 0 legacy .pmc-menu-btn, the drawer opens with the toggle and closes when you tap the scrim, and nothing overflows on all 6 pages at both widths. Both earlier bugs are fixed: (a) bo-flow at 390 is a 2-column grid showing all 7 tiles with nothing clipped, and at 820 it scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 1086 vs 780), so all 7 tiles can be reached; (b) when the drawer is open its brand header sits on top of the mobile top bar (elementFromPoint(40,30) is .pmc-brand__n inside .pmc-side). CRITICAL: the PMC Staff dashboard (/staff) has no responsive layout. At 390 the fixed 236px sidebar leaves the main column only 82px wide, so headings break one character per line and tabs cannot be used. The escrow dashboard (/escrow/me) has the same problem (main column about 135px). Several smaller responsive bugs on public pages are listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: Not responsive at all: all styling is inline, there are no media queries, and the aside has width:236 + flexShrink:0 inside a flex row with 24px padding and gap. At 390 the main column is 82px wide, so headings like 'ESCROW DOCUMENTS — YOUR SIGNATURE' wrap one character per line and the Completed filters (date/select/Export CSV) are squashed into 48px. The page cannot be used on a phone. It works at 820 (main 512px) but there is no drawer and no hamburger.

Two Sign-out controls on screen at once: the PmcMobileNav admin/staff top bar has [data-testid=pmc-mobile-signout] and the staff header has [data-testid=staff-logout]. The two headers stack to about 182px of chrome before any content.

Same problem as staff: a fixed ~255px light sidebar stays visible at 390, leaving the main column about 135px. 'Overview' breaks as 'Overvi/ew' and the KPI cards [escrow-kpi-pending], [escrow-kpi-accounts] are clipped past the right edge (right=422 at 390). There is no drawer or hamburger for the escrow nav. The only hamburger is the generic public PmcMobileNav one, which opens the public menu, not the escrow menu. The public mobile top bar also stacks on top of the escrow header (double header). No visible sign-out control was found on the page.

ui_bugs.component: SignInE (/login, also where /staff and /admin/e/* redirect when logged out)
ui_bugs.issue: At 820 the right half of the form is clipped. The form (440px) overflows its column to right=898; the 'Forgot password?' link, the input right edges and the register button are cut off. Root cause: SignInE.jsx line 212 uses <section style={{display:'grid',placeItems:'center',padding:48}}>, and the implicit grid track sizes to the form's 440px. Fix: add gridTemplateColumns:'minmax(0,1fr)' to the section, or set the form to width:'100%', maxWidth:440 (or stack the 2-column layout below ~900px).

Two hamburgers are visible: the global PmcMobileNav [pmc-mobile-menu-open] at top 12, and the shared TopBar [topbar-hamburger] at top 72 (apps/shared/TopBar.jsx:159). Two stacked headers. The other public pages show only one.

Buttons in the 'Still stuck?' card overflow the card and the viewport (right=426): [help-ticket-open], the tenders@ mail button, and the 'Account & access: adminsupport@…' link (text is cut off). The overflow is hidden by body overflow-x:hidden, so it shows as clipping. Needs width:100%/min-width:0 or flex-wrap, plus word-break for the email.

The CTA row 'Register as supplier' + 'Take the 2-minute tour' (HomeE.jsx:201: flex with no flexWrap) overflows to right=403-411, and the 'Download the brief' button is clipped. The ledger/hash ref chips (.pmc-ref/.pmc-hash) also end at 420. Add flexWrap:'wrap'.
The 'Download security overview' button is clipped (181-425px). TrustSecurityE.jsx:88 is a flex row with no wrap.
There is no overflow, but the body content (Scope heading, scope cards) is flush against the left edge (x=0) with no horizontal padding, while the right side has a gap. The padding is inconsistent.

When closed, the drawer sits at left=viewport width via translateX(100%) but keeps its box-shadow (0 16px 40px rgba(10,29,23,.22)). This leaves a grey gradient strip on the right edge of every page at 390 and 820 (visible in all screenshots: vendor, staff, escrow, login, board). Fix: box-shadow:none or visibility:hidden when the drawer is not open.

design_issues.screen: PMC Staff dashboard vs admin/vendor/escrow (user's 'not mimicking' report)
issues: Admin: AdminShellE has a .pmc-adm grid, a dark .pmc-side sidebar (brand + grouped nav) and a white sticky .pmc-atop (crumb, search, Create, Help, bell, avatar). At 1100px and below the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by one hamburger (admin-nav-toggle) with a scrim. Vendor: dark .pmc-vtop (hamburger, brand 'Supplier portal', search, Help, bell, avatar+company), a .pmc-lnav drawer at 820, and a mobile top bar plus bottom tab bar at 390.

Staff: StaffDashboard.jsx uses none of the theme classes (no pmc-adm/pmc-side/pmc-atop/pmc-vtop). It is all inline styles in a 1200px centered container: a dark full-width band with a 'STAFF PORTAL' eyebrow, an h1 '{name} — {role}', the email and an underlined 'Sign out' text link.
Staff has no brand/logo, no search, no notifications bell, no avatar, no breadcrumb, no Help button in the header, and no hamburger or drawer at any width.

Staff sidebar is a light rounded card with plain text buttons. There are no icons and no section groups, unlike the dark grouped icon nav in admin or the icon nav in vendor. The active state uses a primary fill with a brass left border, which differs from admin's brass pill.
Staff content is centered with maxWidth:1200 while admin/vendor are full-bleed shells. KPI cards use an auto-fit grid with different typography than admin .pmc-stat cards.
The header h1 reads 'Escrow Agent — Escrow Agent' for escrow@ (the user name equals the role label), which looks like a bug.
The Completed tab uses native <input type=date> (browser default picker), not the shared date component.

Recommendation: build a StaffShellE that reuses the AdminShellE pattern and CSS (.pmc-adm/.pmc-side/.pmc-atop/.pmc-navtoggle/.pmc-side__scrim) with the staff nav items, and have the PmcMobileNav staff branch drop its own Sign out (or hide staff-logout below 768px). Apply the same to EscrowMePage.
The PmcMobileNav admin top bar (back, brand, Sign out; 64px) stacks above .pmc-atop (hamburger, Create, bell, avatar; 62px), about 126px of chrome. Functional but heavy; consider merging.
Bidding Ops filter row uses native date inputs (created from/to).
bo-flow scrolls sideways but there is no scroll hint or fade, so tiles 6-7 (Accounts, Awarded) are off-screen with no cue.
The 'Help & FAQs' item is indented differently from the other .pmc-lnav items.
The vendor .pmc-menu-btn hamburger has no data-testid.
Static phone-frame mockup gallery; fits at 390 and 820 with no overflow. The help FAB overlaps the 'ESCROW' status pill inside the frame at 390.

action_items: CRITICAL: Make /staff responsive and consistent with the admin shell. Wrap StaffDashboard in a shared shell (reuse the AdminShellE CSS classes: sidebar becomes a drawer at 1100px and below with a single hamburger and scrim) and remove the fixed 236px non-shrinking aside in a flex row.
HIGH: Remove the duplicate Sign-out on staff mobile (pmc-mobile-signout + staff-logout) and collapse the double header.
HIGH: Make /escrow/me responsive in the same way (sidebar becomes a drawer, KPI cards wrap), and give the escrow nav its own hamburger instead of the public PmcMobileNav menu.
HIGH: Fix SignInE.jsx line 212 right column clipping at 820 (gridTemplateColumns:'minmax(0,1fr)' or form width:100%).
MEDIUM: Remove the duplicate hamburger on /tenders/all at 390 (hide TopBar topbar-hamburger when PmcMobileNav is showing, or the reverse).
MEDIUM: Add flexWrap or full-width buttons for /help 'Still stuck?' card buttons, the HomeE.jsx:201 CTA row and the TrustSecurityE.jsx:88 CTA row at 390.
LOW: Hide the closed .pmc-drawer box-shadow (grey strip on the right edge of every page).
LOW: Add horizontal padding to the notice detail body at 390; add a scroll affordance to bo-flow at 820; fix the staff h1 'name — role' duplication.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffDashboard.jsx (511 lines) is fully inline-styled with no responsive rules; it should reuse the theme shell classes.
PmcMobileNav renders its own Sign out for /staff and /admin while those shells also render sign-out. Pick one owner per shell.

Flex rows of CTA buttons in the E pages (HomeE, TrustSecurityE, HelpCentreE) lack flexWrap. body overflow-x:hidden/clip hides the overflow, so it shows up as silent clipping instead of a horizontal scroll, and scrollWidth checks alone miss it.

bidding-ops.css line 93 still says overflow-x:visible inside @media(max-width:760px). That is fine because the rule switches to a 2-column grid; the overflow-x:auto that makes 820 scroll is on the base rule at line 10.

success_rate.frontend: Admin-E 100% (12/12 page-width checks); overall about 65%: staff and escrow fail at 390, plus 6 smaller public-page and login clipping bugs

test_credentials: Used admin adminsupport@ / Admin@12345 (/admin/login; wait about 3s for hydration before filling, otherwise the fields get reset), vendor manualvendor@ / Vendor@12345, staff escrow@ / Escrow@123 (needs staff-login-role=escrow_agent selected), escrow account escrowdemo@ / Escrow@12345 (already seeded; lands on /escrow/me).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measure overflow with getBoundingClientRect().right > clientWidth per element, not only documentElement.scrollWidth: body has overflow-x hidden/clip, so scrollWidth always equals clientWidth. Exclude the off-canvas .pmc-drawer (help drawer, left=cw). Staff login needs a role select. A sample notice is PMC-NOT-2026-0102. Admin-E shell and the bo-flow/drawer fixes are verified; focus retest on /staff and /escrow/me at 390, /login at 820, /tenders/all hamburger count, and /help, /, /trust CTA clipping at 390.
